settings.geoRestart: The GEO update schedule takes effect on the next core start.
settings.tabHelp: ←→ Switch tab · Tab Move to settings
settings.allowLANHint: Uses the saved bind address when enabled.

settings.processHint: As needed looks up processes only when a rule requires it.
